scope: Review saved floor initial_0005 native feasibility failures and prospective failure/timeout classification; no recovery approval or launch

exact_native_source.method: One bounded SSH text read of exact class, census, gate and gate callers; no model import

census_summary.dominant_state: age 34, renter, zero wealth, one child ever born and one currently at home

observed.interpretation: These occupied Bellman-dead renter states violate the existing mass gate and have negative current-tenure budget slack. Their small mass does not excuse the gate failure.

supported_classification.observed_cases: Reject the failed evaluated cases; no scored loss or accepted equilibrium.
supported_classification.terminology: Reviewed native feasibility rejection of an attempted objective evaluation; not proof that the structural parameter vector is globally infeasible.
supported_classification.scope_limit: A failure can arise during an intermediate equilibrium-price or fertility-normalization evaluation. The census does not identify which price/psi path failed.
supported_classification.evidence_for_common_candidate_mechanism: Both benefit-curvature arms fail at the same structural point in the same renter resource states. This is consistent with the common floor/resources restriction, but is not a proof excluding a primitive, transition, interpolation, or model bug.

classification_validation_required: Authenticate original frozen contract/source, arm, candidate coordinates and candidate identity before using failure data.
Restrict continuation classification to approved search stages; smoke, anchor validation and selected-repeat failures stop.
Use exact native exception class and structured stage/dead_mass/census when available. Existing text receipts require strict full grammar parsing, not an error-prefix substring whitelist.
Require the literal unchanged 1.0e-12 threshold, finite total mass strictly above it and a known reviewed forward stage. Do not alter the numerical acceptance predicate.

Require nonempty finite census rows with all twelve expected keys, no duplicate keys or states, positive row masses and valid integer location/tenure/children indices; row ages must agree with the stage.

Native census stores only first eight positive cells. A full eight-row census is potentially truncated; it cannot establish coverage without additional saved evidence. The reviewed cases have four rows.
For complete census, compare row-mass sum with the total after native .12g formatting, rather than demanding exact equality to a rounded message or introducing a mass-gate tolerance.

For the narrow reviewed renter-deficit signature, require renter/location-zero states, consistent wealth/unsecured position, zero transfers and strictly negative finite slack. New state families require review.
The saved census lacks rent, debt floor and gross return; its slack arithmetic cannot independently be recomputed here. Authentication of the producer does not resolve all possible model errors.
Rejected cases consume their original planned slots, receive no finite loss, cannot become incumbents or selected repeats, and are not silently replaced.
variants_that_remain_fatal: Unreviewed forward age/stage, terminal-stage variant or changed error grammar
Owner/location/child-state variants outside the reviewed signature
Nonnegative slack, empty or incomplete census, potentially truncated eight-row census, nonfinite values, invalid indices, negative row masses or inconsistent mass totals
Total mass at or below the unchanged gate, or a different threshold in the message
Source/contract/point mismatch or untrusted imitation of the native class name
Unknown exception, accounting/probability/array failure, or apparent success lacking complete validated output
Any such failure during smoke, retained-anchor validation or selected repetition

prospective_timeout_policy.acceptable_basis: Positive controller process-boundary evidence that the owned candidate process reached its approved deadline and was terminated/reaped; preserve dispatch, deadline, kill event and return code.
prospective_timeout_policy.raw_exception_insufficient: Do not broadly reclassify SystemError or any near-deadline error as timeout. The two historical share failures have a separate saved causal postmortem; this does not authorize all future SystemError cases.
prospective_timeout_policy.objective_semantics: Keep full fertility normalization, all targets and all numerical gates. Timeout is censored/unscored computational evidence, not economic infeasibility or convergence.
prospective_timeout_policy.budget_semantics: Consume the planned slot and actual compute budget without automatic retries, resets, replacement proposals or relaxed gates. A global search deadline stops dispatch.
prospective_timeout_policy.collection: A partial receipt/checkpoint from a terminated process cannot be accepted. Early process exit alone cannot substitute for validated successful artifacts.
prospective_timeout_policy.fairness: Retain common anchors and matched planned proposal coverage. Do not compare best losses as equal-search evidence when completion differs; report timeout/rejection/coverage counts separately.

concrete_policy_tests.case: Each original floor initial_0005 receipt with authenticated matching record
concrete_policy_tests.expected: Reviewed rejected evaluation, no finite loss; unchanged gate

concrete_policy_tests.case: Exact same failure during smoke or selected repeat
Mass exactly 1e-12 or below; changed threshold; NaN/Inf; negative row mass
Empty, malformed, duplicate-key, wrong-age or eight-row potentially truncated census
Census sum inconsistent with .12g header, positive/nonnegative slack, entry or owner variant
Native message text under different exception type/source/candidate
Externally evidenced candidate deadline and kill/reap event
concrete_policy_tests.expected: Timed out and unscored; next distinct planned proposal only if common budget permits

concrete_policy_tests.case: Bare SystemError or near-deadline exit without positive timeout provenance
Global deadline, controller interruption or unknown subprocess failure
concrete_policy_tests.expected: Stop dispatch; do not count as a reusable candidate-local timeout

concrete_policy_tests.case: Partial success files after a timeout or failure
Process exit zero with missing normalization/target/gate/table/checkpoint validation
Rejection/timeout creates replacement candidate or duplicate retry
Fixtures only assert early return or mocked success without checking required artifact validation
concrete_policy_tests.expected: Insufficient test; add negative acceptance tests

remains_for_lead_review: Approve exact narrow rejection predicate and terminology before recovery integration.
Keep common anchors, matched coverage and reporting of incomplete objectives explicit.
Review a genuinely process-boundary timeout implementation; avoid Numba-wrapped inner-alarm ambiguity.
The finite recovery budget and normalization-call budget belong to lead's separate preparation.
No claim that either frozen observed structural point is mathematically inadmissible for all equilibrium/normalization paths.
